Applied Econometrics explicitly teaches IV, FE, matching, DiD and RDD with R and causal interpretation. UCR OLS/GLS/IV and experimental-design teaching are real strengths; missing named specialist identification methods are not inferred present.

Environmental Economics explicitly integrates climate science with economic damage/abatement/social-carbon-cost, discounting, intergenerational justice and an integrated assessment model. Physical climate, life-cycle analysis and governance are complementary, not that complete economic modelling course.

Economics/Inequality combines distribution metrics and capabilities; Migration and Labour Economics have specific economic theories, policy instruments and evidence. Generic sociology/leadership does not replace those specialist courses.

Package A European Law concerns internal market/regulatory law; Social Law explicitly includes individual/collective employment and social-security doctrine. UCR EU/constitutional/public-policy study has genuine connections but does not supply Dutch fiscal/social doctrine.
